vulnerabilities.explanation: The current logic in `checkEligibility` incorrectly identifies voters younger than 18 as eligible. The condition `age < 18` should result in an 'ineligible' message, while `age >= 18` should lead to eligibility. The current implementation has this logic inverted. The fix involves swapping the conditions to correctly identify eligible voters.
vulnerabilities.matched_commit_message: fix(query-devtools/utils): scope the 'setupStyleSheet' dedup check to the target so a 'shadowDOMTarget' still receives its own '#_goober' style tag when 'document.head' already has one (#10815)
